comments.text: I did crowd control work at the 2026 World Cup in ‘Boston’. For the first match, on one entrance, security only had two gates open instead of the 6+. When they saw a crowd control event starting to happen, they opened all the other gates to relieve the pressure. People did not really get security checked, but at least everyone was safe.
